Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy applies to MileMaster, developed and published by American Group LLC, on iOS and Android.

ApplicationMileMaster
iOS bundle idcom.americangroupllc.milemaster
Android packagecom.americangroupllc.milemaster
DeveloperAmerican Group LLC
Contactcontact@americangroup.ai

Accounts

The app does not require registration and does not create user accounts or profiles.

Device permissions

The app asks for the following permissions only when you use the related feature, and each request explains its purpose with the text below. You can decline any of them and keep using the rest of the app.

  • Location (while using the app) — Measures the distance of a drive while you have one running in MileMaster. Location is used only in the foreground, the log stays on this device, and you can log trips by hand instead.

Android permissions declared: ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.

Advertising

The app does not show advertisements and does not include an advertising SDK.

Purchases

The app has no in-app purchases.

Analytics and crash reporting

This release sends no analytics and no crash reports to us. If a future version enables crash reporting, this page will be updated first.

Network

The app declares no network permission on Android and works entirely on your device.

Data retention and deletion

Data the app stores lives on your device and is removed when you uninstall the app.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you by emailing contact@americangroup.ai. We answer within 30 days.

Changes

We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new date.
